payload.text:
1  # Physics Toy Factory p5 API
     2  
     3  This is the complete p5.js surface accepted by `p5check.js`. Generated `sketch.js` files must use
     4  global mode, define `setup()` and `draw()`, call `createCanvas()`, and perform at least one visible draw
     5  call. APIs not listed here are unsupported. Asset loading, networking, storage, DOM access, audio,
     6  video, WebGL, shaders, offscreen graphics, and dynamic code generation are forbidden.
     7  
     8  The checker is a bounded smoke judge, not a visual or semantic grader. It runs `setup()` once,
     9  `draw()` for five deterministic frames, and each defined input callback once.
    10  
    11  ## Lifecycle callbacks
    12  
    13  `setup`, `draw`, `windowResized`, `mousePressed`, `mouseReleased`, `mouseMoved`, `mouseDragged`,
    14  `keyPressed`, `keyReleased`
    15  
    16  ## Canvas and environment
    17  
    18  Functions: `createCanvas`, `resizeCanvas`, `frameRate`, `millis`
    19  
    20  Values: `width`, `height`, `windowWidth`, `windowHeight`, `frameCount`, `deltaTime`
    21  
    22  ## Input
    23  
    24  `mouseX`, `mouseY`, `pmouseX`, `pmouseY`, `mouseIsPressed`, `key`, `keyCode`, `keyIsPressed`
    25  
    26  ## 2D drawing
    27  
    28  `background`, `clear`, `point`, `line`, `triangle`, `quad`, `rect`, `square`, `ellipse`, `circle`,
    29  `arc`, `bezier`, `curve`
    30  
    31  ## Shapes
    32  
    33  `beginShape`, `vertex`, `curveVertex`, `bezierVertex`, `endShape`
    34  
    35  ## Style
    36  
    37  `fill`, `noFill`, `stroke`, `noStroke`, `strokeWeight`, `strokeCap`, `strokeJoin`, `colorMode`,
    38  `rectMode`, `ellipseMode`, `blendMode`
    39  
    40  ## Text
    41  
    42  `text`, `textSize`, `textAlign`
    43  
    44  ## Transform
    45  
    46  `push`, `pop`, `translate`, `rotate`, `scale`, `angleMode`
    47  
    48  ## Color
    49  
    50  `color`, `red`, `green`, `blue`, `alpha`, `lerpColor`
    51  
    52  ## Random and noise
    53  
    54  `random`, `randomSeed`, `noise`, `noiseDetail`, `noiseSeed`
    55  
    56  Randomness and input values are deterministic inside the checker. The browser uses p5.js normally.
    57  
    58  ## Math
    59  
    60  `abs`, `ceil`, `constrain`, `dist`, `exp`, `floor`, `lerp`, `log`, `mag`, `map`, `max`, `min`,
    61  `norm`, `pow`, `round`, `sq`, `sqrt`, `sin`, `cos`, `tan`, `asin`, `acos`, `atan`, `atan2`,
    62  `degrees`, `radians`
    63  
    64  ## Constants
    65  
    66  `PI`, `TWO_PI`, `HALF_PI`, `QUARTER_PI`, `TAU`, `CENTER`, `CORNER`, `CORNERS`, `RADIUS`, `CLOSE`,
    67  `OPEN`, `CHORD`, `PIE`, `RGB`, `HSB`, `HSL`, `DEGREES`, `RADIANS`, `ADD`, `BLEND`, `ROUND`,
    68  `SQUARE`, `PROJECT`, `MITER`, `BEVEL`
    69  
    70  ## Vectors
    71  
    72  Create a vector with `createVector` as `createVector(x, y)`. Instance methods are `set`, `copy`, `add`, `sub`, `mult`,
    73  `div`, `mag`, `magSq`, `normalize`, `setMag`, `limit`, `heading`, `rotate`, `dot`, `dist`, and `lerp`.
    74  
    75  Static methods are `p5.Vector.add`, `p5.Vector.sub`, `p5.Vector.mult`, `p5.Vector.div`,
    76  `p5.Vector.dist`, `p5.Vector.lerp`, `p5.Vector.fromAngle`, and `p5.Vector.random2D`.
    77  
    78  ## Explicitly unsupported examples
    79  
    80  The checker reports `Unsupported p5 API: <name>` for recognized APIs outside this product contract,
    81  including `loadImage`, `loadJSON`, `loadSound`, `createVideo`, `createElement`, `createGraphics`,
    82  `WEBGL`, `WEBGPU`, `shader`, `loadShader`, `createCapture`, and `createAudio`.
    83  
    84  Misspellings and all other unknown identifiers remain undefined and fail normally. The checker never
    85  turns unknown calls into no-ops.
